Gideon's July update in #strategic-pod put Vantorre Group at **280 seats**.

He first posted 300 on July 1, then corrected it to 280 about two minutes later. The 300 had included sandbox logins from the May rollout. Ruth acknowledged 280 as the figure to use. Source: #strategic-pod, 2026-07-01 09:19.
